prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web dashboard comp for MabarQueue, a streamer tool for running a Mobile Legends VIP mabar queue with synthetic data. Make this variation queue-led: a wide ordered queue is the dominant work area, with a compact current-player strip above it, a slim left navigation, a session status header, and a right rail for quick actions and recent donations. Show Indonesian labels, player names, ready and offline states, donation providers, positions, and matches remaining. Include the named action Tambah Pemain. Use the Fillmore handbill direction as a restrained world through warm cream ground, saturated red and mustard ink, deep navy contrast, expressive display typography, bold flat surfaces, and a single continuous printed-sheet treatment behind the working queue. Keep normal web components, crisp table controls, clear hierarchy, accessible contrast, and readable realistic text. Show plausible entries Raka ML, Nisa Gaming, Bimo Stream, Doni Katsu. Edge-to-edge screen with no browser frame or device. The image must look like a real operating dashboard, never a poster or abstract artwork.
